title: NRITYAM: Language Models Meet Art and Heritage of Dance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot accuracy on a multilingual and multimodal dataset of multiple-choice questions focusing on the history, rules, and scenarios of traditional global dances from 12 countries to measure comprehension of non-Western and indigenous cultures.

Comparing model performance (accuracy) on multiple-choice questions translated across 12 different languages to measure cross-lingual disparities between high-resource languages (e.g., German, French) and low-resource languages (e.g., Maori, Amharic).
